title: Execution limits
description: The circuit-breaker policy and the dispatch budget of one pack, as data (Architect ruling A3; AGENT-16: agents do not set thresholds, so no number lives in code). The per-capability error rate, window and timeout stay in capability-descriptor.v1 limits. SYNTHETIC configuration (AGENT-25). Changing a value is a pack change reviewed by the Founders.

pack_id.description: The pack's vertical prefix, as in pack.v1 pack_id.

min_samples.description: Outcomes in the window before the error rate can open the circuit.

cooldown_s.description: Seconds an open circuit waits before it lets one probe through, on the injected clock (INV-21), never wall time.

half_open_probes.description: Probes allowed while half open. The breaker supports exactly one.

key.description: The fields that make up the budget key, in exactly this order: tenant_id, correlation_id, capability, target_ref. JSON Schema here checks the four names; the order is checked by the loader in services/core/execution/limits, which refuses any other order.
